ticker_news.title: Did China's DeepSeek Just Crash and Burn President Trump's $500 Billion AI Stargate Project?
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the potential impact of a Chinese AI startup, DeepSeek, on President Trump's $500 billion Stargate AI infrastructure project. It analyzes the spending plans of major tech companies like Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, and Amazon, and concludes that DeepSeek is not derailing the Stargate project.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: US Stocks Set For A Cautious Start Ahead Of Inflation Data: Expert Says 'Strong Bull Markets Tend To Roar Back To Life After Corrections'
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures fell ahead of the release of inflation data, with traders expecting a modest report that could signal easing price pressures and potential interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve. Experts noted a 'weak recovery' in the market, but sentiment remains constructive.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra

SPY.title: Inflation Rises More Than Expected In January, Chills Interest Rate Cut Hopes
SPY.description: Inflation surged more than expected in January, with CPI rising 3% year-over-year and 0.5% month-over-month, exceeding forecasts and dampening investor hopes for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
